title: La Glace Clean Social Listening Report
author: Natth
summary: Clean social listening dataset for La Glace using verified/keyword-matched public comments. Current dataset contains 2,965 records, led by TikTok official videos and supported by Instagram, X, Facebook, and YouTube samples.

methodology.source: Bright Data TikTok official video comments, Instagram comments, Facebook comments, YouTube comments, and Apify X replies. TikTok excludes unrelated 14k mixed scrape records and keeps only @laglace_official/keyword-matched sources.
methodology.selection: Includes only records with auditable source URLs or source IDs from the collected clean files. The TikTok bulk scrape was filtered at source-video level to official La Glace videos before inclusion.
methodology.sentimentMethod: Rule-based Thai/English text classification from the scraped text only. Positive = praise, liking, purchase intent, or good experience. Neutral = question/factual/general reaction. Negative = complaint, dissatisfaction, concern, or problem mention.
limitations: TikTok has much larger coverage than other platforms because official TikTok source videos produced the highest available comment volume.
Facebook and YouTube remain limited samples because discovered source posts/videos had low visible comment volume.
X collection stopped at the available Apify quota, so X should be interpreted as a sample rather than full-platform coverage.
Automated sentiment and topic labels should be reviewed before final publishing, especially for slang, sarcasm, and emoji-only messages.

insights.title: TikTok official videos provide the strongest clean signal
insights.description: The clean report includes 2,237 TikTok records after filtering to official/keyword-matched videos.
insights.recommendation: Use TikTok comments as the main evidence base, but label other channels as supporting samples.

insights.title: Purchase intent and availability questions are a clear conversion opportunity
insights.description: 24 records mention purchase intent, price, stock, shades, or where-to-buy signals.
insights.recommendation: Turn recurring shade, stock, and purchase questions into pinned FAQ, reply templates, and commerce links.

insights.title: Cross-platform comparison should be presented carefully
insights.description: Non-TikTok platforms are smaller samples: Instagram 468, X 170, Facebook 65, YouTube 25.
insights.recommendation: Frame the dashboard as a clean evidence explorer, not a complete market share comparison across platforms.
